82	### 2.1 Index discipline: pointed covers, arbitrary opens
83	
84	```lean
85	/-- A pointed open cover of a scheme: one open per point, containing it. -/
86	structure Scheme.PointedCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
87	  opens : X → X.Opens
88	  mem_opens : ∀ x, x ∈ opens x
89	```
90	
91	with the refinement preorder `𝒱 ≤ 𝒰 ↔ ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x`.
92	
93	Decision rationale (each alternative was weighed):
94	
95	- **Not finite covers, not affine covers, not `Set X.Opens`.** Pointed covers give:
96	  (a) *smallness for free* — the index type is the fixed carrier `X : Type u`, so the sigma type
97	  in §2.3 stays in `Type u`; (b) *canonical refinement maps* — a refinement `𝒱 ≤ 𝒰` refines
98	  **indexwise** (`𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x`), so the cocycle-restriction map needs no choice of a
99	  reindexing function and no "independence of the refinement map" lemma at the carrier level;
100	  (c) *directedness by pointwise `⊓`* (`(𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens x := 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x`), so the
101	  refinement colimit is filtered; (d) *clean pullback* — for `f : X ⟶ Y` the pulled-back cover is
102	  `x ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens (f x))`, again pointed, again indexed by the carrier. Affineness
103	  constraints would break (d) (preimages of affines are not affine); `Set`-indexing breaks (b)
104	  (pullback collapses indices).
105	- Affine or finite covers re-enter as *cofinality lemmas*, not as carrier structure: every
106	  pointed cover is refined by a pointed affine cover (`x ↦` an affine open neighbourhood inside
107	  `𝒰.opens x`; the choice lives inside a `Prop`, so no data escapes). This is where the
108	  2-cover computations of the χ-ledger and the T₀ engine plug in.
109	
110	### 2.2 The cocycle layer: build on `PresheafOfGroups.H1`
111	
112	**Decision: build on mathlib's fixed-family layer**, not hand-rolled. Instantiation:
113	
114	```lean
115	/-- The units presheaf of a scheme, on its small Zariski site. -/
116	def Scheme.unitsPresheaf (X : Scheme.{u}) : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat.{u} :=
117	  X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat CommMonCat ⋙ CommMonCat.units
118	-- (OPEN-4: if the `forget₂ CommRingCat CommMonCat` path is absent in v4.31, a ~20-line
119	-- bespoke functor replaces the composition; the statement shape is unchanged.)
120	
121	abbrev Scheme.unitsCocycle (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) :=
122	  PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) 𝒰.opens
123	```
124	
125	Here the site category is the poset `X.Opens`, the family is `𝒰.opens : X → X.Opens`, and
126	mathlib's `OneCochain/OneCocycle/OneCohomologyRelation/IsCohomologous/H1` + `One (H1 G U)`
127	(`Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/NonabelianCohomology/H1.lean:58–197`) come for free. On a poset
128	with infima, the `ev (i j) (a : T ⟶ U i) (b : T ⟶ U j)`-style cochain is *equivalent* to the
129	classical pair data `g x y ∈ 𝒪ˣ(𝒰x ⊓ 𝒰y)` with the cocycle condition on triple infima: homs
130	are subsingletons, so `ev` is determined by its value at `T = 𝒰x ⊓ 𝒰y` via `ev_precomp`, and
131	`ev_trans` at the triple infimum is the classical condition. **Binding ergonomic requirement**:
132	`Picard/CechH1.lean` must provide the two-way bridge so lane agents never touch `ev` directly:
133	
134	```lean
135	/-- Build a 1-cocycle over a poset with binary infima from classical pair data. -/
136	def PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.ofPairs
137	    (g : ∀ x y, G.obj (op (𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens y)))
138	    (hg : ∀ x y z, /- restrictions to the triple infimum satisfy g x y · g y z = g x z -/) :
139	    OneCocycle G 𝒰.opens
140	lemma ev_inf (γ : OneCocycle G 𝒰.opens) (x y) : γ.ev x y ⋯ = ⋯   -- extraction at the infimum
141	```
142	
143	Additions ours to make (all in `Picard/CechH1.lean`, stated generically over any `Cᵒᵖ ⥤
144	CommGrpCat.{w}` — a mathlib-PR candidate, their file's TODO list asks for exactly this):
145	
146	- `Mul/Inv/CommGroup (OneCocycle Gc U)` when the presheaf is commutative-group-valued (the
147	  product of cocycles satisfies `ev_trans` only using commutativity), and the descended
148	  `CommGroup (H1 Gc U)` via `Quot.map₂` (compatibility of `IsCohomologous` with products again
149	  uses commutativity).
150	- Restriction along an indexwise refinement `res : H1 G 𝒰 →* H1 G 𝒱` for `𝒱 ≤ 𝒰`
151	  (on cocycles: restrict values along the inclusions; strictly functorial:
152	  `res_res : res h₂ ∘ res h₁ = res (h₁.trans h₂)` holds on the nose at cochain level).
153	
154	### 2.3 The refinement colimit
155	
156	```lean
157	/-- The definitional Picard group: Čech H¹ of the units presheaf, colimit over pointed covers. -/
158	def Scheme.CechPic (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u :=
159	  Quot (fun p q : (Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, PresheafOfGroups.H1 ⋯ 𝒰.opens) =>
160	    ∃ 𝒲, ∃ (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ p.1) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ q.1), res h₁ p.2 = res h₂ q.2)
161	```
162	
163	- The relation is an equivalence *because the poset is directed* (common refinement by pointwise
164	  `⊓`) and `res` strictly composes; the standard filtered-colimit argument is elementary and
165	  choice-free.
166	- Universe accounting: `X.PointedCover : Type u`, each `H1 … : Type u` (index `X : Type u`,
167	  values in `Type u`), the sigma is `Type u`, the quotient is `Type u`. **No `ULift` anywhere.**
168	- `CommGroup (X.CechPic)`: multiplication of classes represented on a common refinement;
169	  well-definedness from §2.2's `CommGroup (H1 …)` + `res` being a group hom.
170	- Constructor/eliminator API: `CechPic.mk (𝒰) (γ : OneCocycle …) : X.CechPic`,
171	  `CechPic.ind`, `CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff_of_refines`, and the "sanity gate"
172	  `CechPic (Spec (.of K)) ≃* PUnit`-style triviality for fields (one-point space, one cover,
173	  `ev_refl` kills every cocycle) — this is Lane 1's cheap end-to-end test.
174	
175	### 2.4 Group structure: multiplicative, `CommGrpCat`-valued
176	
177	**Decision: multiplicative.** Justification (each item load-bearing):
178	
179	1. The cocycle values are *units of rings*; their native structure is multiplicative, and
180	   `tensor product of line bundles = pointwise multiplication of transition units`,
181	   `dual = pointwise inverse` — recon lesson 1's entire point. An additive carrier would
182	   re-introduce a translation layer at exactly the spot the old draft burned.
183	2. `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` takes `F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w}` — multiplicative — and
184	   `forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat` is the canonical bridge. The old draft's
185	   `AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}` choice cost both a universe bump and an additive/multiplicative
186	   mismatch at the representability gate.
187	3. Mathlib's `PresheafOfGroups.H1` layer (§2.2) is multiplicative.
188	
189	The `ℤ`-valued *degree* (§6) is additive; the interface between the multiplicative Pic and the
190	additive degree is a single `→ ℤ` map with `deg (a * b) = deg a + deg b` — pinned as such, no
191	`Multiplicative ℤ` gymnastics in consumer-facing statements.
192	
193	### 2.5 Functoriality: pullback of cocycles
194	
195	```lean
196	def Scheme.CechPic.map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic
197	theorem Scheme.CechPic.map_id (X) : CechPic.map (𝟙 X) = MonoidHom.id _
198	theorem Scheme.CechPic.map_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
199	    CechPic.map (f ≫ g) = (CechPic.map f).comp (CechPic.map g)
200	```
201	
202	On representatives: pull the cover back pointwise through `f.base` (`x ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f x)`),
203	pull the units back through `f.app`, restrict. `map_comp` compares the covers
204	`(f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰 (g (f x))` and `f ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰 (g (f x)))` — equal opens
205	(`Scheme.preimage_comp`), with the value comparison through `Scheme.Hom.app_comp`; if defeq
206	friction appears, prove it through the refinement relation (both sides restrict to a common
207	refinement) rather than `eqToHom` surgery.
208	
209	### 2.6 Divisor classes as cocycles: the `𝒪(D)` constructor
210	
211	Three constructors, in dependency order. Sign convention (route §3, audited in §8):
212	a local-equation system `(fᵢ)` for an effective `D` produces the class of `𝒪(D)` with
213	transition units `g x y = f x / f y` on overlaps (trivialization of `𝒪(D)` on `𝒰x` by
214	multiplication by `f x`).
215	
216	**(a) Local-equation data → class** (`Picard/DivisorClass.lean`):
217	
218	```lean
219	/-- Local equations for an effective Cartier divisor, adapted to a pointed cover. -/
220	structure Scheme.LocalEquations (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
221	  cover : X.PointedCover
222	  eqn : ∀ x, Γ(X, cover.opens x)
223	  regular : ∀ x, /- eqn x is a nonzerodivisor in every stalk over cover.opens x -/
224	  ratio_isUnit : ∀ x y, IsUnit (/- (eqn x)/(eqn y) as a section on the overlap, i.e.
225	      ∃ u : unit on 𝒰x ⊓ 𝒰y, (eqn x)|∩ = u * (eqn y)|∩ -/)
226	
227	def Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass (d : X.LocalEquations) : X.CechPic
228	  -- the class of the cocycle (x,y) ↦ the unit u x y with (eqn x)|∩ = u x y • (eqn y)|∩
229	```
230	
231	with: uniqueness of `u x y` (regularity makes the ratio unit unique — this is why `regular` is
232	part of the data), the cocycle identity for `u` (from associativity of the ratios),
233	*independence*: two `LocalEquations` cutting out the same closed subscheme (or related by
234	unitwise rescaling) have equal `picClass`; *multiplicativity*: pointwise product of equations ↦
235	product of classes; *pullback compatibility*: for `f : X' ⟶ X` such that the pulled-back
236	equations are still regular (guaranteed in the relative situation below),
237	`(d.pullback f).picClass = CechPic.map f d.picClass`.
238	
239	**(b) The two geometric instances** (`Picard/GraphDivisor.lean`):
240	
241	- *Point divisor.* For a `k`-point `P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C`, the image of `P` is an
242	  effective Cartier divisor on `C.left`: the local ring at the image point is a DVR
243	  (`Curve/StalksDVR.lean`, Wave 1), so a uniformizer spreads to a local equation, and away from
244	  the point the equation `1` works. Output: `pointDivisor P : C.left.LocalEquations` (cover:
245	  a distinguished pointed cover; the choice of uniformizer is data *inside* the construction,
246	  with `picClass`-level independence proven — see the choice-discipline note in §4.4).
247	- *Graph divisor.* The diagonal `Δ ⊂ (C ⊗ C).left` is a relative effective divisor over the
248	  **second** factor: `pr₂|Δ` is an isomorphism onto the base, in particular finite flat of rank
249	  1, and smoothness of `C/k` of relative dimension 1 makes the conormal module invertible, so
250	  the ideal of `Δ` is locally one regular equation. Deliverable:
251	
252	  ```lean
253	  def graphLocalEquations (t : T ⟶ C /- in Over (Spec k) -/) :
254	      ((C ⊗ T).left).LocalEquations   -- local equations for Γ_t := (C ◁ t)-pullback of Δ ⋯
255	  theorem graphLocalEquations_base_change ⋯  -- Γ_{t ∘ g} equations = pullback of Γ_t equations
256	  ```
257	
258	  The base-change stability is *by construction*: `Γ_t` is the pullback of the universal `Δ`
259	  along `C ◁ (t ≫ ⋯)`, and (a)'s pullback compatibility applies because `Δ` is a *relative*
260	  divisor over the test factor (fibers never contain a component of `C`), so regularity
261	  survives every base change. Rank certificate: `𝒪_{Γ_t} ≅ 𝒪_T` as `T`-algebras, so the
262	  finite-flat rank of `Γ_t → T` is 1 — the input for the degree of `abelElement` (§6).
263	  This mathematics is Kleiman `ex:DivC` (§3.8: `X₀ = Div¹_{X/S}` for the smooth locus) and
264	  `rmk:Jac` (§5.26: "Given `t : T → X`, its graph subscheme `Γ_t ⊂ X × T` is a relative
265	  effective divisor"); both read.
266	
267	**(c) The meromorphic bridge** (`Picard/MeromorphicTrivialization.lean`; needed by the degree,
268	see §6.1): for `X` *integral*, every `CechPic` class is a divisor class. Cocycle proof shape:
269	every nonempty open contains the generic point; fix a base index `x₀` and localize the cocycle

271	divisor whose class is the given one. (Classical statement: Kleiman quotes it in the proof of
272	`th:qpp&p` (§5.4): "Since `X × T` is integral, there is a divisor `D` such that `𝒪(D) = 𝓛`
273	by [Hartshorne, Ex. II 6.15]".) This file also pins `divisorClass` for *differences*

87	/-! ## Pointed covers -/
88	
89	/-- A pointed open cover of a scheme: one open per point, containing it. Pointed covers
90	are the index discipline of `Scheme.CechPic`: the index type is the carrier of `X` (so
91	everything stays in `Type u`), refinement is indexwise, and pointwise `⊓` makes the
92	refinement order directed. -/
93	structure PointedCover (X : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
94	  /-- The member of the cover attached to a point. -/
95	  opens : X → X.Opens
96	  /-- Each point lies in its member. -/
97	  mem_opens : ∀ x, x ∈ opens x
98	
99	namespace PointedCover
100	
101	@[ext]
102	lemma ext {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : ∀ x, 𝒰.opens x = 𝒱.opens x) : 𝒰 = 𝒱 := by
103	  cases 𝒰; cases 𝒱
104	  simpa using funext h
105	
106	instance : SemilatticeInf X.PointedCover where
107	  le 𝒱 𝒰 := ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x
108	  le_refl 𝒰 x := le_rfl
109	  le_trans 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := (h₁ x).trans (h₂ x)
110	  le_antisymm 𝒰 𝒱 h₁ h₂ := ext fun x ↦ le_antisymm (h₁ x) (h₂ x)
111	  inf 𝒰 𝒱 :=
112	    { opens := fun x ↦ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x
113	      mem_opens := fun x ↦ ⟨𝒰.mem_opens x, 𝒱.mem_opens x⟩ }
114	  inf_le_left 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_left
115	  inf_le_right 𝒰 𝒱 x := inf_le_right
116	  le_inf 𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 h₁ h₂ x := le_inf (h₁ x) (h₂ x)
117	
118	instance : OrderTop X.PointedCover where
119	  top := { opens := fun _ ↦ ⊤, mem_opens := fun _ ↦ trivial }
120	  le_top _ _ := le_top
121	
122	lemma le_def {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰 ↔ ∀ x, 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x :=
123	  Iff.rfl
124	
125	@[simp]
126	lemma inf_opens (𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover) (x : X) :
127	    (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens x = 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x :=
128	  rfl
129	
130	@[simp]
131	lemma top_opens (x : X) : (⊤ : X.PointedCover).opens x = ⊤ :=
132	  rfl

134	/-- The pullback of a pointed cover along a morphism of schemes: the pointed cover by
135	preimages, `x ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f x)`. -/
136	def pullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) : X.PointedCover where
137	  opens x := f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f.base x)
138	  mem_opens x := 𝒰.mem_opens (f.base x)
139	
140	@[simp]
141	lemma pullback_opens (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) (x : X) :
142	    (𝒰.pullback f).opens x = f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.opens (f.base x) :=
143	  rfl

145	lemma pullback_mono (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 𝒱 : Y.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) :
146	    𝒱.pullback f ≤ 𝒰.pullback f :=
147	  fun x ↦ ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).map (homOfLE (h (f.base x)))).le

158	abbrev unitsH1 (X : Scheme.{u}) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) : Type u :=

161	/-- Restriction of unit Čech classes along a refinement of pointed covers, as a group
162	homomorphism. -/
163	def unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (h : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) : X.unitsH1 𝒰 →* X.unitsH1 𝒱 :=
164	  H1.resHom fun x ↦ homOfLE (h x)

166	/-- Restriction along refinements of pointed covers is strictly functorial. -/
167	@[simp]
168	lemma unitsRes_unitsRes {𝒰 𝒱 𝒲 : X.PointedCover} (h₁ : 𝒱 ≤ 𝒰) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒱)
169	    (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) : unitsRes h₂ (unitsRes h₁ a) = unitsRes (h₂.trans h₁) a :=
170	  H1.res_res _ _ a

173	lemma unitsRes_rfl {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} {h : 𝒰 ≤ 𝒰} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
174	    unitsRes h a = a :=
175	  H1.res_id a
176	/-- If `U` is contained in the preimages of two opens, it is contained in the preimage
177	of their intersection. -/
178	lemma Hom.le_preimage_inf (f : X.Hom Y) {U : X.Opens} {V₁ V₂ : Y.Opens}
179	    (h₁ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₁) (h₂ : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₂) : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (V₁ ⊓ V₂) :=
180	  fun _ hx ↦ ⟨h₁ hx, h₂ hx⟩

182	/-- The pair value `γ.evInf i j` of a unit Čech cocycle, retyped as a unit section in
183	`Γ(X, 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)ˣ` (definitionally equal). Statements phrased through
184	`unitsEvInf` are honestly `Γ`-typed, so `rw`/`simp` work on them; goals arising from the
185	`OneCochain` field types are closed against them by `exact` (definitional bridging). -/
186	def unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
187	    Γ(X, 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)ˣ :=
188	  γ.evInf i j

190	/-- Restriction of a unit section along `W ≤ U`, as a group homomorphism between the
191	honest `Γ`-typed unit groups (definitionally the units-presheaf restriction map). -/
192	abbrev unitsRestrict (X : Scheme.{u}) {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U) :
193	    Γ(X, U)ˣ →* Γ(X, W)ˣ :=
194	  Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
195	
196	@[simp]
197	lemma one_unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (i j : X) :
198	    unitsEvInf (1 : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) i j = 1 :=
199	  rfl

202	lemma mul_unitsEvInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ₁ γ₂ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
203	    unitsEvInf (γ₁ * γ₂) i j = unitsEvInf γ₁ i j * unitsEvInf γ₂ i j :=
204	  rfl

206	/-- The cocycle identity for the pair values, in unit-section language. -/
207	lemma unitsEvInf_trans {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j k : X) :
208	    X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
209	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)
210	        (unitsEvInf γ i j)
211	      * X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right :
212	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)
213	          (unitsEvInf γ j k)
214	      = X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left :
215	          𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k ≤ 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)
216	          (unitsEvInf γ i k) :=
217	  γ.evInf_trans i j k

219	/-- Restriction along a refinement, at the level of pair values. -/
220	lemma res_unitsEvInf {𝒲 𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (hle : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰)
221	    (i j : X) :
222	    unitsEvInf (γ.res fun k ↦ homOfLE (hle k)) i j
223	      = X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf (hle i) (hle j)) (unitsEvInf γ i j) :=
224	  γ.res_evInf _ i j

229	/-- Pullback of the cocycle identity: the pair values of a unit cocycle on `Y`, pulled
230	back through `f : X ⟶ Y` to a common open `T`, still satisfy the cocycle identity. -/
231	private lemma pullback_pair_trans (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 : Y.PointedCover}
232	    (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j k : Y) {T : X.Opens}
233	    (e₁ : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j)) (e₂ : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k))
234	    (e₃ : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens k)) :
235	    f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j) T e₁ (unitsEvInf γ i j)
236	      * f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) T e₂ (unitsEvInf γ j k)
237	      = f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) T e₃ (unitsEvInf γ i k) := by
238	  have E : T ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) :=
239	    fun t ht ↦ ⟨e₁ ht, (e₂ ht).2⟩
240	  have ht := congrArg (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ⊓ 𝒰.opens k) T E)
241	    (unitsEvInf_trans γ i j k)
242	  rw [map_mul, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE,
243	    Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at ht
244	  exact ht

247	pointed cover. -/
248	def pullbackUnitsCocycle (f : X ⟶ Y) (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
249	    X.unitsCocycle (𝒰.pullback f) where
250	  ev x y _ a b :=
251	    f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) _
252	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) (unitsEvInf γ (f.base x) (f.base y))
253	  ev_precomp x y _ _ φ a b :=
254	    f.unitsAppLE_map (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) φ.op
255	      (unitsEvInf γ (f.base x) (f.base y))
256	  ev_trans x y z _ a b c :=
257	    pullback_pair_trans f γ (f.base x) (f.base y) (f.base z)
258	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le b.le) (f.le_preimage_inf b.le c.le)
259	      (f.le_preimage_inf a.le c.le)

295	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_res (h : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰) (γ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) :
296	    (f.pullbackUnitsCocycle γ).res (fun x ↦ homOfLE (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h x))
297	      = f.pullbackUnitsCocycle (γ.res (fun y ↦ homOfLE (h y))) := by

300	    (f.unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒲.opens (f.base y)) T

306	/-- Pullback of a single coboundary comparison along a morphism of schemes: the honest
307	`Γ`-typed computation behind `pullbackUnitsCocycle_isCohomologous`. -/
308	private lemma pullback_coboundary (f : X ⟶ Y) {𝒰 : Y.PointedCover}
309	    (γ₁ γ₂ : Y.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (α : ∀ i : Y, Γ(Y, 𝒰.opens i)ˣ)
310	    (hα : ∀ i j, Y.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left : 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ≤ 𝒰.opens i) (α i)
311	          * unitsEvInf γ₁ i j
312	        = unitsEvInf γ₂ i j
313	          * Y.unitsRestrict (inf_le_right : 𝒰.opens i ⊓ 𝒰.opens j ≤ 𝒰.opens j) (α j))
314	    (x y : X) {T : X.Opens}
315	    (ha : T ≤ (𝒰.pullback f).opens x) (hb : T ≤ (𝒰.pullback f).opens y) :
316	    X.unitsRestrict ha
317	        (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x)) ((𝒰.pullback f).opens x) le_rfl
318	          (α (f.base x)))
319	      * f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
320	          (f.le_preimage_inf ha hb) (unitsEvInf γ₁ (f.base x) (f.base y))
321	      = f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T
322	          (f.le_preimage_inf ha hb) (unitsEvInf γ₂ (f.base x) (f.base y))
323	        * X.unitsRestrict hb
324	            (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base y)) ((𝒰.pullback f).opens y) le_rfl
325	              (α (f.base y))) := by
326	  have h' := congrArg
327	    (f.unitsAppLE (𝒰.opens (f.base x) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (f.base y)) T (f.le_preimage_inf ha hb))
328	    (hα (f.base x) (f.base y))
329	  rw [map_mul, map_mul, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE, Scheme.Hom.map_unitsAppLE] at h'
330	  rw [Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map, Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE_map]
331	  exact h'

339	      (α (f.base x)),
340	    fun x y T a b ↦ pullback_coboundary f γ₁ γ₂ α
341	      (fun i j ↦ hα i j (homOfLE inf_le_left) (homOfLE inf_le_right)) x y a.le b.le⟩

42	instance cechPicSetoid (X : Scheme.{u}) : Setoid (Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) where
43	  r p q := ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ p.1) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ q.1),
44	    unitsRes h₁ p.2 = unitsRes h₂ q.2
45	  iseqv := by
46	    constructor
47	    · exact fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, le_rfl, le_rfl, rfl⟩
48	    · rintro p q ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
49	      exact ⟨𝒲, h₂, h₁, e.symm⟩
50	    · rintro p q r ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩
51	      refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_left.trans h₁, inf_le_right.trans h₄, ?_⟩
52	      have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁

66	  ⟦⟨𝒰, a⟩⟧

70	    (mk : ∀ (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰), motive (mk 𝒰 a)) (x : X.CechPic) :
71	    motive x :=

75	    mk 𝒰 a = mk 𝒱 b ↔

81	particular `mk` is invariant under restriction. -/

87	private def mulSig (p q : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
88	    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
89	  ⟨p.1 ⊓ q.1, unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2⟩

98	          unitsRes inf_le_right (unitsRes inf_le_left b * unitsRes inf_le_right c)) := by
99	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱 ⊓ 𝒳, le_rfl, (inf_assoc 𝒰 𝒱 𝒳).le, ?_⟩

103	private lemma mulSig_compat {p p' q q' : Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰}
104	    (hp : p ≈ p') (hq : q ≈ q') : mulSig p q ≈ mulSig p' q' := by
105	  obtain ⟨𝒲₁, h₁, h₂, e₁⟩ := hp
106	  obtain ⟨𝒲₂, h₃, h₄, e₂⟩ := hq
107	  have e₁' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_left : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₁)) e₁
108	  have e₂' := congrArg (unitsRes (inf_le_right : 𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂ ≤ 𝒲₂)) e₂
109	  simp only [unitsRes_unitsRes] at e₁' e₂'
110	  refine ⟨𝒲₁ ⊓ 𝒲₂, inf_le_inf h₁ h₃, inf_le_inf h₂ h₄, ?_⟩
111	  show unitsRes (inf_le_inf h₁ h₃) (unitsRes inf_le_left p.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q.2)
112	      = unitsRes (inf_le_inf h₂ h₄) (unitsRes inf_le_left p'.2 * unitsRes inf_le_right q'.2)
113	  simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes]
114	  rw [e₁', e₂']

116	instance : CommGroup X.CechPic where
117	  mul := Quotient.map₂ mulSig (fun _ _ hp _ _ hq ↦ mulSig_compat hp hq)
118	  one := mk ⊤ 1
119	  inv := Quotient.map (fun p ↦ ⟨p.1, p.2⁻¹⟩) (by

122	  mul_assoc a b c := by
123	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
124	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
125	    induction c using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒳 c =>

129	    show mk (⊤ ⊓ 𝒰) (unitsRes inf_le_left (1 : X.unitsH1 ⊤) * unitsRes inf_le_right a)

131	    rw [map_one, one_mul, mk_unitsRes]

147	    induction a using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
148	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>

152	    simp only [map_mul, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]

156	  rfl

158	/-- Multiplication of Picard classes on representatives: restrict both to the common
159	refinement `𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱` and multiply there. Holds by definition. -/
160	lemma mk_mul_mk_inf {𝒰 𝒱 : X.PointedCover} (a : X.unitsH1 𝒰) (b : X.unitsH1 𝒱) :
161	    mk 𝒰 a * mk 𝒱 b

165	@[simp]

167	  Quotient.sound ⟨𝒰, le_rfl, le_top, by rw [map_one, map_one]⟩
168

170	lemma mk_mul_mk (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) (a b : X.unitsH1 𝒰) :
171	    mk 𝒰 a * mk 𝒰 b = mk 𝒰 (a * b) := by
172	  rw [mk_mul_mk_inf]
173	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒰, le_rfl, inf_le_left, ?_⟩

181	
182	private def mapSig (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : Σ 𝒰 : Y.PointedCover, Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
183	    Σ 𝒰 : X.PointedCover, X.unitsH1 𝒰 :=
184	  ⟨p.1.pullback f, f.pullbackUnitsH1 p.1 p.2⟩
185	
186	private lemma mapSig_compat (f : X ⟶ Y) :
187	    ∀ {p q : Σ 𝒰 : Y.PointedCover, Y.unitsH1 𝒰}, p ≈ q → mapSig f p ≈ mapSig f q := by
188	  rintro ⟨𝒰, a⟩ ⟨𝒱, b⟩ ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, e⟩
189	  refine ⟨𝒲.pullback f, PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₁,
190	    PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₂, ?_⟩
191	  show unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₁) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
192	      = unitsRes (PointedCover.pullback_mono f h₂) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b)
193	  rw [Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 f h₁ a, Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1 f h₂ b, e]

195	/-- Contravariant functoriality of the Čech Picard group: pull the cover back pointwise,
196	pull the unit cocycles back through `f`, restrict. -/
197	def map (f : X ⟶ Y) : Y.CechPic →* X.CechPic where
198	  toFun := Quotient.map (mapSig f) fun _ _ h ↦ mapSig_compat f h
199	  map_one' := by
200	    show mk ((⊤ : Y.PointedCover).pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 ⊤ 1) = 1
201	    rw [map_one, mk_one]

204	    induction b using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
205	    show mk ((𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).pullback f)
206	        (f.pullbackUnitsH1 (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱) (unitsRes inf_le_left a * unitsRes inf_le_right b))

208	          mk (𝒱.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒱 b)
209	    rw [mk_mul_mk_inf]
210	    refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨(𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).pullback f, le_rfl,
211	      le_inf (PointedCover.pullback_mono f inf_le_left)
212	        (PointedCover.pullback_mono f inf_le_right), ?_⟩
213	    simp only [map_mul, ← Hom.unitsRes_pullbackUnitsH1, unitsRes_unitsRes, unitsRes_rfl]

216	lemma map_mk (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.PointedCover) (a : Y.unitsH1 𝒰) :
217	    map f (mk 𝒰 a) = mk (𝒰.pullback f) (f.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) :=
218	  rfl

220	/-- Pullback of Picard classes along the identity is the identity. -/
221	@[simp]
222	theorem map_id (X : Scheme.{u}) : map (𝟙 X) = MonoidHom.id X.CechPic := by
223	  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
224	  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
225	  show mk (𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X)) ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a) = mk 𝒰 a
226	  have hle : 𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X) ≤ 𝒰 := fun x ↦ le_of_eq (by simp)
227	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰.pullback (𝟙 X), le_rfl, hle, ?_⟩
228	  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
229	  refine congrArg (Quot.mk _) ?_
230	  ext x y T a b
231	  rw [OneCocycle.res_ev, OneCocycle.res_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev,
232	    γ.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf]
233	  exact id_unitsAppLE _ _

235	/-- Pullback of Picard classes along a composite (the lane keystone). -/
236	theorem map_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) : map (f ≫ g) = (map f).comp (map g) := by
237	  refine MonoidHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
238	  induction x using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
239	  show mk (𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g)) ((f ≫ g).pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a)
240	    = mk ((𝒰.pullback g).pullback f)
241	        (f.pullbackUnitsH1 (𝒰.pullback g) (g.pullbackUnitsH1 𝒰 a))
242	  have hle : 𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g) ≤ (𝒰.pullback g).pullback f := fun x ↦ le_of_eq (by simp)
243	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰.pullback (f ≫ g), le_rfl, hle, ?_⟩
244	  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ =>
245	  refine congrArg (Quot.mk _) ?_
246	  ext x y T a b
247	  rw [OneCocycle.res_ev, OneCocycle.res_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev,
248	    Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_ev, Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, unitsAppLE_unitsAppLE]
249	  rfl
250	
251	/-! ## Sanity gate: triviality over a field -/
252	
253	/-- On a scheme with a subsingleton underlying space — e.g. `Spec` of a field — the
254	Čech Picard group is trivial: every pointed cover is a cover by a single open, on which
255	every unit cocycle is a coboundary. -/
256	instance subsingleton_of_subsingleton (X : Scheme.{u}) [Subsingleton X] :
257	    Subsingleton X.CechPic := by
258	  refine ⟨fun p q ↦ ?_⟩
259	  induction p using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒰 a =>
260	  induction q using CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒱 b =>
261	  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱, inf_le_left, inf_le_right, ?_⟩
262	  have := H1.subsingleton_of_forall_le (X.unitsPresheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat)
263	    (𝒰 ⊓ 𝒱).opens (fun i j ↦ le_of_eq (congrArg _ (Subsingleton.elim i j)))
264	  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
265	
266	/-- The Čech Picard group of the spectrum of a field is trivial. -/
267	theorem eq_one_of_subsingleton (X : Scheme.{u}) [Subsingleton X] (x : X.CechPic) :
268	    x = 1 :=
269	  Subsingleton.elim x 1
270	
271	example {K : Type u} [Field K] (x : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).CechPic) : x = 1 :=
272	  eq_one_of_subsingleton _ x

13	This file extends Mathlib's fixed-family nonabelian Čech layer
14	(`CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle`, `H1`) with the three pieces of
15	infrastructure needed for a Čech-style Picard group (all stated generically; this file
16	is a Mathlib-PR candidate and contains no algebraic geometry):
17	
18	1. **Restriction along an indexwise refinement.** For families `U V : I → C` and maps
19	   `f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U i`, cochains/cocycles/`H1`-classes restrict along `f`, strictly
20	   functorially (`res_res` holds on the nose at the cochain level).
21	2. **The poset bridge.** Over a poset with binary infima, a 1-cochain is determined by
22	   its values `evInf i j` at the infima `U i ⊓ U j` (`ev_eq_evInf`), and a 1-cocycle can
23	   be built from classical pair data satisfying the cocycle condition at triple infima
24	   (`OneCocycle.ofPairs`). Consumers never need to touch `ev` directly.
25	3. **Commutative group structure.** When the presheaf takes values in `CommGrpCat`,
26	   1-cocycles form a commutative group under pointwise multiplication (the cocycle
27	   condition for products needs commutativity) and this descends to `H1`; restriction
28	   is then a group homomorphism (`H1.resHom`).
29

31	
32	* `CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCochain.res`, `OneCocycle.res`, `H1.res`:

35	  binary infima, evaluation of a cochain at `U i ⊓ U j` determines it.
36	* `CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.ofPairs`: the classical construction of a
37	  cocycle from pair data `g i j` on binary infima with the triple-infimum condition.
38	* `CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.isCohomologous_iff_evInf`: the coboundary
39	  relation in classical pair form.

43	  `CommGroup (H1 (G ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) U)` for `G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat`.

191	
192	private lemma map_map (G : Pᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{w}) {a b c : P} (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : b ≤ c)
193	    (x : G.obj (op c)) :
194	    G.map (homOfLE h₁).op (G.map (homOfLE h₂).op x) = G.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op x := by
195	  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
196	
197	namespace OneCochain
198	
199	/-- The value of a 1-cochain on the binary infimum `U i ⊓ U j`. Over a poset with binary
200	infima this determines the whole cochain, see `ev_eq_evInf`. -/
201	def evInf (γ : OneCochain G U) (i j : I) : G.obj (op (U i ⊓ U j)) :=
202	  γ.ev i j (homOfLE inf_le_left) (homOfLE inf_le_right)
203	
204	/-- Over a poset, a 1-cochain is determined by its values on binary infima. -/
205	lemma ev_eq_evInf (γ : OneCochain G U) (i j : I) {T : P} (a : T ⟶ U i) (b : T ⟶ U j) :
206	    γ.ev i j a b = G.map (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le)).op (γ.evInf i j) := by
207	  have h := γ.ev_precomp i j (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le))
208	    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i)) (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j))
209	  rw [Subsingleton.elim (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le) ≫ homOfLE inf_le_left) a,
210	    Subsingleton.elim (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le) ≫ homOfLE inf_le_right) b] at h
211	  exact h.symm
212	
213	/-- Restriction commutes with evaluation at binary infima. -/
214	lemma res_evInf {V : I → P} (γ : OneCochain G U) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U i) (i j : I) :
215	    (γ.res f).evInf i j
216	      = G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf (f i).le (f j).le)).op (γ.evInf i j) :=
217	  γ.ev_eq_evInf i j (homOfLE inf_le_left ≫ f i) (homOfLE inf_le_right ≫ f j)

226	
227	/-- Restriction commutes with evaluation at binary infima. -/
228	lemma res_evInf {V : I → P} (γ : OneCocycle G U) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U i) (i j : I) :
229	    (γ.res f).evInf i j
230	      = G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf (f i).le (f j).le)).op (γ.evInf i j) :=
231	  γ.toOneCochain.res_evInf f i j
232	
233	/-- The classical cocycle condition for the pair values of a 1-cocycle: on the triple
234	infimum, `g i j * g j k = g i k`. -/
235	lemma evInf_trans (γ : OneCocycle G U) (i j k : I) :
236	    G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U i ⊓ U j)).op (γ.evInf i j) *
237	        G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U j ⊓ U k)).op
238	          (γ.evInf j k) =
239	      G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U i ⊓ U k)).op
240	        (γ.evInf i k) := by
241	  have h := γ.ev_trans i j k (T := U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k)
242	    (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)) (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right))
243	    (homOfLE inf_le_right)
244	  simp only [γ.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf] at h
245	  exact h
246	
247	/-- Build a 1-cocycle over a poset with binary infima from classical pair data: values
248	`g i j` on the binary infima satisfying the cocycle condition on triple infima. -/
249	def ofPairs (g : ∀ i j, G.obj (op (U i ⊓ U j)))
250	    (hg : ∀ i j k,
251	      G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U i ⊓ U j)).op (g i j) *
252	          G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U j ⊓ U k)).op
253	            (g j k) =
254	        G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⊓ U k ≤ U i ⊓ U k)).op
255	          (g i k)) :
256	    OneCocycle G U where
257	  ev i j _ a b := G.map (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le)).op (g i j)
258	  ev_precomp i j T T' φ a b := map_map G φ.le (le_inf a.le b.le) (g i j)
259	  ev_trans i j k T a b c := by
260	    rw [← map_map G (le_inf (le_inf a.le b.le) c.le) inf_le_left (g i j),
261	      ← map_map G (le_inf (le_inf a.le b.le) c.le) (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_right) (g j k),
262	      ← map_map G (le_inf (le_inf a.le b.le) c.le) (inf_le_inf_right _ inf_le_left) (g i k),
263	      ← map_mul, hg i j k]
264	
265	@[simp]
266	lemma ofPairs_ev (g : ∀ i j, G.obj (op (U i ⊓ U j))) (hg) (i j : I) {T : P}
267	    (a : T ⟶ U i) (b : T ⟶ U j) :
268	    (ofPairs g hg).ev i j a b = G.map (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le)).op (g i j) :=
269	  rfl
270	
271	@[simp]
272	lemma ofPairs_evInf (g : ∀ i j, G.obj (op (U i ⊓ U j))) (hg) (i j : I) :
273	    (ofPairs g hg).evInf i j = g i j := by
274	  change G.map (homOfLE (le_inf (homOfLE inf_le_left).le (homOfLE inf_le_right).le)).op (g i j)
275	      = g i j
276	  have h : homOfLE (le_inf (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i)).le
277	      (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j)).le) = 𝟙 (U i ⊓ U j) :=
278	    Subsingleton.elim _ _
279	  rw [h, op_id, G.map_id]
280	  rfl
281	
282	/-- Round trip: rebuilding a 1-cocycle from its pair values gives it back. -/
283	lemma evInf_ofPairs (γ : OneCocycle G U) :
284	    ofPairs (fun i j ↦ γ.evInf i j) (fun i j k ↦ γ.evInf_trans i j k) = γ := by
285	  ext1
286	  ext i j T a b
287	  exact (γ.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf i j a b).symm
288	
289	/-- The coboundary relation in classical pair form: two 1-cocycles over a poset with
290	binary infima are cohomologous iff there are sections `α i` on the `U i` conjugating the
291	pair values into each other. -/
292	lemma isCohomologous_iff_evInf (γ₁ γ₂ : OneCocycle G U) :
293	    γ₁.IsCohomologous γ₂ ↔ ∃ α : ZeroCochain G U, ∀ i j,
294	      G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U i)).op (α i) * γ₁.evInf i j =
295	        γ₂.evInf i j * G.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ≤ U j)).op (α j) := by
296	  constructor
297	  · rintro ⟨α, hα⟩
298	    exact ⟨α, fun i j ↦ hα i j (homOfLE inf_le_left) (homOfLE inf_le_right)⟩
299	  · rintro ⟨α, hα⟩
300	    refine ⟨α, fun i j T a b ↦ ?_⟩
301	    have h' := congrArg (G.map (homOfLE (le_inf a.le b.le : T ≤ U i ⊓ U j)).op ·) (hα i j)
302	    simp only [map_mul, map_map] at h'
303	    rw [γ₁.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf i j a b, γ₂.toOneCochain.ev_eq_evInf i j a b]
304	    exact h'
305	
306	end OneCocycle
307

Let `A → B` be a map of commutative rings and let `M` be a `B`-module.  This file defines
descent data on `M` relative to `A → B`, constructs the descended `A`-module `M₀` as an
equalizer submodule of `M`, and proves the two fundamental theorems of flat descent for
modules:

* **effectivity**: if `B` is flat over `A`, the canonical comparison map
  `B ⊗[A] M₀ → M` is an isomorphism;
* **uniqueness**: if `B` is faithfully flat over `A`, then any `A`-module `N` equipped with
  a `B`-module isomorphism `B ⊗[A] N ≃ M` matching the descent datum is canonically
  isomorphic to `M₀`.  The engine is the degree `≤ 1` exactness of the Amitsur complex
  `0 → N → B ⊗[A] N ⇉ B ⊗[A] B ⊗[A] N`.

## Design notes

* **Comodule form of a descent datum.**  Classically a descent datum on `M` is a
  `B ⊗[A] B`-module isomorphism `φ : M ⊗[A] B ≃ B ⊗[A] M` satisfying a cocycle condition
  over the triple tensor product.  We use the equivalent *comodule* (Sweedler-coring)
  presentation: a `B`-linear coaction `δ : M →ₗ[B] B ⊗[A] M` (with `B` acting on the left
  tensor factor of the target) such that
  - (`counit`) the action map `B ⊗[A] M → M`, `b ⊗ₜ m ↦ b • m`, retracts `δ`, and
  - (`coassoc`) the two natural liftings of `δ` to `B ⊗[A] B ⊗[A] M` agree on the image
    of `δ`.

  associated to a coaction is automatically invertible.  This presentation avoids putting

* **The descended module** is the equalizer `M₀ = {m : M | δ m = 1 ⊗ₜ m}`, an `A`-submodule

import Mathlib.RingTheory.Etale.Field
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Smooth.Flat
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.FaithfullyFlat.Algebra
import Mathlib.RingTheory.FinitePresentation

/-!
# Presented étale covers of an affine base

A (singleton, affine) *étale cover* of `Spec A` is a faithfully flat étale `A`-algebra `B`.
For the étale-sheafification (plus) construction of the relative Picard functor, the covers
of a fixed base must form a *small* directed index: this file realizes them as **presented**
covers — a number of variables `n` together with an ideal of `MvPolynomial (Fin n) A` whose
quotient is étale over `A` with `Spec` mapping onto `Spec A`.  The type of presented covers
of `A` lives in the same universe as `A`, while still capturing every étale cover up to
isomorphism of the carrier (`Algebra.EtaleCover.of` and its accessor `ofEquiv`).

Surjectivity of the spectrum map is recorded instead of faithful flatness because it is
statable without flatness hypotheses; combined with flatness of étale algebras it *is*
faithful flatness (`Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_comap_surjective`), and that instance is
provided on the carrier.

## Main declarations

* `Algebra.EtaleCover A`: presented étale covers of `Spec A`, a `Type u` for `A : Type u`;
  `E.Carrier` is the covering algebra, with `Algebra.Etale A E.Carrier` and
  `Module.FaithfullyFlat A E.Carrier` instances.
* `Algebra.EtaleCover.of B hB`: any étale `A`-algebra `B` (with surjective spectrum map)
  underlies a presented cover, with carrier identification `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv`.
* `Algebra.EtaleCover.Refines`: `E'` refines `E` when the covering spectrum of `E'` maps
  to that of `E` over the base — a mere existence (`Prop`); the plus construction proves
  independence of the chosen refinement map, so no choice of map is carried here.
* `Algebra.EtaleCover.prod`: the common refinement `Spec (B ⊗[A] B')` of two covers, with
  refinement witnesses `prodInl`/`prodInr` — directedness of the index
  (`exists_refines_prod`).
* `Algebra.EtaleCover.self`: the trivial cover `Spec A` itself, refined by every cover
  (`refines_self`) — the base point of the index.
* `Algebra.EtaleCover.baseChange`: the pulled-back cover along `A → A'`, with carrier
  `A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier` (`baseChangeEquiv`) and the canonical `A`-algebra map
  `baseChangeInclude` into it.
* `Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`: over a field `K`, every cover
  is refined by a finite separable field extension of `K` (single-factor refinement) —
  field-extension covers are cofinal, the form the degree theory and Galois descent
  consume; `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField` packages such an extension as a cover.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open TensorProduct

namespace Algebra

/-- A presented étale cover of `Spec A`: a finite-variable polynomial presentation of an
étale `A`-algebra whose spectrum maps onto `Spec A`.  Presentations keep the type of covers
small (`Type u` for `A : Type u`), which is what makes the étale plus construction over
these covers a legitimate colimit; the carrier-level content is recovered by
`Algebra.EtaleCover.of`/`ofEquiv`. -/
structure EtaleCover (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : Type u where
  /-- The number of variables of the presentation. -/
  n : ℕ
  /-- The ideal of relations of the presentation. -/
  ideal : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)
  /-- The presented algebra is étale over the base. -/
  etale : Algebra.Etale A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ ideal)
  /-- The spectrum of the presented algebra covers the spectrum of the base. -/
  comap_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ ideal)))

namespace EtaleCover

variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A]

/-- The covering algebra presented by an étale cover. -/
protected abbrev Carrier (E : EtaleCover A) : Type u :=
  MvPolynomial (Fin E.n) A ⧸ E.ideal

instance (E : EtaleCover A) : Algebra.Etale A E.Carrier :=
  E.etale

instance (E : EtaleCover A) : Module.FaithfullyFlat A E.Carrier :=
  .of_comap_surjective E.comap_surjective

/-! ## Constructors -/

section constructors

variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.Etale A B]

/-- Package an explicitly presented étale algebra with surjective spectrum map as a
presented étale cover: the ideal of relations is the kernel of the presenting
surjection. -/
noncomputable def ofSurjective
    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B)))
    {n : ℕ} (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →ₐ[A] B) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    EtaleCover A where
  n := n
  ideal := RingHom.ker f
  etale := .of_equiv (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hf).symm
  comap_surjective := by
    haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B := .of_comap_surjective hB
    haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ RingHom.ker f) :=
      .of_linearEquiv (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hf).toLinearEquiv
    exact PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat

/-- The carrier of `ofSurjective` is the presented algebra. -/
noncomputable def ofSurjectiveEquiv
    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B)))
    {n : ℕ} (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →ₐ[A] B) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (ofSurjective hB f hf).Carrier ≃ₐ[A] B :=
  Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hf

/-- Any étale `A`-algebra whose spectrum covers `Spec A` underlies a presented étale
cover.  The presentation is chosen (étale algebras are finitely presented, in particular
finitely generated); the choice is harmless because consumers only ever use the carrier
identification `ofEquiv`. -/
noncomputable def of (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.Etale A B]
    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B))) : EtaleCover A :=
  ofSurjective hB
    (Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial''.mp inferInstance).choose_spec.choose
    (Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial''.mp inferInstance).choose_spec.choose_spec

/-- The carrier of `of B hB` is `B` itself. -/
noncomputable def ofEquiv (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.Etale A B]
    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B))) :
    (of B hB).Carrier ≃ₐ[A] B :=
  ofSurjectiveEquiv hB _ _

end constructors

/-! ## Refinement and directedness -/

/-- `E'` refines `E`: the covering spectrum of `E'` maps to that of `E` over `Spec A`,
i.e. there is an `A`-algebra map from the carrier of `E` to that of `E'`.  This is a mere
existence: the plus construction proves that the induced maps on descent classes do not
depend on the chosen refinement map, so no map is carried here. -/
def Refines (E' E : EtaleCover A) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E'.Carrier)

theorem refines_refl (E : EtaleCover A) : E.Refines E :=
  ⟨AlgHom.id A E.Carrier⟩

theorem Refines.trans {E E' E'' : EtaleCover A} (h : E''.Refines E') (h' : E'.Refines E) :
    E''.Refines E := by
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := h'
  exact ⟨f.comp g⟩

/-- The common refinement of two covers: `Spec` of the tensor product of the carriers,
i.e. the fiber product of the covering spectra over the base. -/
noncomputable def prod (E E' : EtaleCover A) : EtaleCover A :=
  haveI : Algebra.Etale A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
    Algebra.Etale.comp A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
  haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.trans A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
  .of (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat

/-- The carrier of the common refinement is the tensor product of the carriers. -/
noncomputable def prodEquiv (E E' : EtaleCover A) :
    (E.prod E').Carrier ≃ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier :=
  haveI : Algebra.Etale A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
    Algebra.Etale.comp A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
  haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.trans A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
  ofEquiv (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat

/-- The first refinement map of the common refinement. -/
noncomputable def prodInl (E E' : EtaleCover A) : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] (E.prod E').Carrier :=
  ((E.prodEquiv E').symm.toAlgHom).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft

/-- The second refinement map of the common refinement. -/
noncomputable def prodInr (E E' : EtaleCover A) : E'.Carrier →ₐ[A] (E.prod E').Carrier :=
  ((E.prodEquiv E').symm.toAlgHom).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight

theorem prod_refines_left (E E' : EtaleCover A) : (E.prod E').Refines E :=
  ⟨E.prodInl E'⟩

theorem prod_refines_right (E E' : EtaleCover A) : (E.prod E').Refines E' :=
  ⟨E.prodInr E'⟩

/-- Directedness of the refinement preorder: any two covers have a common refinement. -/
theorem exists_refines_prod (E E' : EtaleCover A) :
    ∃ E'' : EtaleCover A, E''.Refines E ∧ E''.Refines E' :=
  ⟨E.prod E', E.prod_refines_left E', E.prod_refines_right E'⟩

/-- The trivial cover of `Spec A` by itself. -/
noncomputable def self (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : EtaleCover A :=
  .of A (by
    rw [show algebraMap A A = RingHom.id A from rfl]
    intro p
    exact ⟨p, by ext : 2 <;> rfl⟩)

/-- The carrier of the trivial cover is the base ring. -/
noncomputable def selfEquiv (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : (self A).Carrier ≃ₐ[A] A :=
  ofEquiv A _

/-- Every cover refines the trivial cover: the trivial cover is the base point of the
refinement preorder. -/
theorem refines_self (E : EtaleCover A) : E.Refines (self A) :=
  ⟨(Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).comp (selfEquiv A).toAlgHom⟩

/-! ## Base change -/

section baseChange

variable (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] [Algebra A A']

/-- The base change of a cover along `A → A'`: the cover of `Spec A'` with carrier
`A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier` (the fiber product of the covering spectrum with the new base). -/
noncomputable def baseChange (E : EtaleCover A) : EtaleCover A' :=
  .of (A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat

/-- The carrier of the base-changed cover is the base-changed carrier. -/
noncomputable def baseChangeEquiv (E : EtaleCover A) :
    (E.baseChange A').Carrier ≃ₐ[A'] A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
  ofEquiv (A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat

/-- The canonical map from the carrier of a cover to the carrier of its base change,
as a map of `A`-algebras. -/
noncomputable def baseChangeInclude (E : EtaleCover A) :
    E.Carrier →ₐ[A] (E.baseChange A').Carrier :=
  (((E.baseChangeEquiv A').symm.toAlgHom).restrictScalars A).comp
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight

end baseChange

/-! ## Covers of a field: single-factor refinement -/

section field

variable {K : Type u} [Field K]

/-- The carrier of a cover of a field (indeed, of any nontrivial base) is nontrivial. -/
theorem nontrivial_carrier (E : EtaleCover A) [Nontrivial A] : Nontrivial E.Carrier :=
  PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.mp
    ⟨(E.comap_surjective (Nonempty.some inferInstance)).choose⟩

/-- **Field cofinality**: over a field, every presented étale cover is refined by a finite
separable field extension.  This single-factor refinement is what makes field-extension
covers cofinal among étale covers of `Spec K`: the étale carrier is a finite product of
finite separable extensions of `K`, and projection to any one factor still covers the
(one-point) spectrum of `K`. -/
theorem exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom (E : EtaleCover K) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
      (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L), Nonempty (E.Carrier →ₐ[K] L) := by
  haveI : Nontrivial E.Carrier := E.nontrivial_carrier
  obtain ⟨I, hI, Ai, hfield, halg, e, h⟩ :=
    (Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod K E.Carrier).mp inferInstance
  haveI : Nonempty I := by
    by_contra hempty
    haveI : IsEmpty I := not_nonempty_iff.mp hempty
    exact false_of_nontrivial_of_subsingleton E.Carrier
      (e.toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr inferInstance)
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty I›
  exact ⟨Ai i, hfield i, halg i, (h i).1, (h i).2,
    ⟨(Pi.evalAlgHom K Ai i).comp e.toAlgHom⟩⟩

variable (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]

instance : Algebra.Etale K L where
  formallyEtale := Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable K L
  finitePresentation := Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp inferInstance

/-- A finite separable field extension as an étale cover of `Spec K` (the spectrum map
between the one-point spectra is trivially surjective). -/
noncomputable def ofField : EtaleCover K :=
  .of L fun p => ⟨default, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

/-- The carrier of the field cover is the field extension itself. -/
noncomputable def ofFieldEquiv : (ofField L).Carrier ≃ₐ[K] L :=
  ofEquiv L _

end field

end EtaleCover

end Algebra
